atoms.b: All herbivores are ((plant-eaters)), and their teeth are shaped to match their diet.
Herbivores have incisors which help them to bite and ((++pull)) grass and roots out of the ground, as well as leaves from branches.
Molars are the big, flat teeth which are at the ((back)) of the jaw.
The molars chew and ((++grind)) the food, before it is swallowed.
Some herbivores, like horses, have ((canines)), but not all herbivores do.
If herbivores do have canines, they are much ((++smaller bigger)) and not as sharp as canines in carnivores and omnivores.
